headless_preflight.note: The Lua runtime and API catalog load before retail game startup; the fixture verifies exported Lua function discovery, invocation, and removal; skill-tree registration, prerequisite gating, rank changes, and reads; native monster model resolution; procedural native dungeon floors through both API names; dungeons.list/get; and the locations.list no-save path. The assetless fixture then stops at the first required retail resource.

headless_determinism.note: Each synthetic headless probe is repeated from two clean roots; stable API and feature markers must match.
